# mGBA core

`mgba.js` and `mgba.wasm` come unchanged from the npm package
`@wasm-gaming/mgba-wasm` 0.1.1 (https://github.com/wasm-gaming/mGBA-wasm),
which builds mGBA (https://github.com/mgba-emu/mgba) at commit
c034660f007c543233f1cadeb0ca13c71afd8f41 with a small flat C shim.

Both are under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (see LICENSE in this folder).
The source for the core and the shim is in those two repositories.
